ABOUT

    

      Every pixel is an independent backward integration of a null geodesic of the
      Schwarzschild metric, evaluated in the fragment shader. There is no mesh, no
      billboard, no texture on a sphere and no pre-rendered footage anywhere in the
      image. The accretion flow is a volumetric field — density is a 3D function of
      radius, height and co-rotating azimuth, and emission is integrated with
      absorption along the ray, so the disk has real thickness and parallax.
